Name: Native Stratagem Radial r23 - Wedge Appearance
Description: Revision 23: adds independent darkness and opacity settings for Experimental Expanded wedges. Defaults to 70 percent darkness and 75 percent opacity; the selected sector remains yellow and icons retain their visibility. Original appearance remains available at darkness 0 and opacity 30. Retains viewport centering, all selection modes and native input. Requires Mod Options Menu, Mod Bindings Menu v2 and Bingus Shared Loader API 1.
